You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: Clean up the table by placing the yellow_block into the purple_box and the blue_book into the orange_tray. First, check if the purple_box is occupied; if it is, clear it by moving the object currently in it (if any) to a valid alternative zone, but only if that zone is empty. Similarly, ensure the orange_tray is empty before placing the blue_book. If the purple_box contains the blue_book, move the blue_book to the orange_tray only after confirming the orange_tray is free. The yellow_block must be placed in the purple_box only if the purple_box is empty or can be cleared. Success is confirmed when both the yellow_block is in the purple_box and the blue_book is on the orange_tray, and no other objects are left on the table.
